questions.question: In the XXI phase of sale of electoral bonds can be only purchase from which of the following institution?

In which of the following ways, aggregate demand function is related to consumption function?
I. They have the same slope C.
II. The aggregate demand function is parallel to the consumption function.
If ex ante aggregate demand and ex ante aggregate supply are plotted together in a graphical diagram, then at which point equilibrium will be reached?
questions.option_1: Where ex ante aggregate demand is less than ex ante aggregate supply
questions.option_2: Where ex ante aggregate demand is more than ex ante aggregate supply
questions.option_3: Where ex ante aggregate demand is zero
questions.option_4: Where ex ante aggregate demand is equal to ex ante aggregate supply

questions.question: Law of Demand states that, there is a negative relationship between ______.
questions.option_1: demand for a commodity and its supply
questions.option_2: tax on a commodity and its price
questions.option_3: demand for a commodity and its price
questions.option_4: supply of a commodity and its price
